content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSET Civil Engineering Krishna School of Emerging Technology & Applied Research develops Civil Engineering students through surveying, structures, materials, geotechnics, environmental systems, and practical field-oriented training. 0 Campus Foundation 0+ Faculty Members 0 Civil Labs 0 Mission Goals LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSET Dr. Lalit Thakur Professor, HOD - Civil Engg. Dept, Director, KSET dr.lalitthakur.cv.kset@kpgu.ac.in Since its inception in 2004, Krishna Edu Campus has established itself as a premier engineering institute in Gujarat. With a commitment to academic excellence, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and a dynamic learning environment, the campus has become a hub for nurturing future engineers and innovators. The Department of Civil Engineering began its journey three years ago with a vision to impart cutting-edge knowledge and skills in the field. Though still a young department, much like a two-leaf sapling, it is poised to grow into a towering tree of excellence over the next decade. We take immense pride in our academic standards and are dedicated to shaping the civil engineers of tomorrow. Our team of energetic and highly qualified faculty members specializes in a wide range of civil engineering domains, blending advanced theoretical knowledge with practical applications. To ensure the quality of education, we emphasize hands-on teaching, rigorous training, continuous assessment, and well-structured tutorials, with regular testing to maximize student potential. The curriculum is periodically updated to keep pace with industry developments, offering students both technical knowledge and practical skills. Our state-of-the-art laboratories provide an application-based learning environment, preparing students for real-world challenges. While we are committed to delivering an exceptional educational experience, we also expect students to work hard, stay dedicated, and strive for academic and personal success. Together, we will build a strong foundation for a bright future in civil engineering. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Civil Engineering at KSET 01 The department of civil engineering at KPGU is well established with high quality laboratories featuring a rich blend of traditional and modern equipment. Our well qualified faculty members from various specialized fields of civil engineering are dedicated to cultivate strong links with the industry, academic institutions, research institutions and consulting firms. 02 It has been crafted to serve as a hub where all the stakeholders can collaborate in optimizing teaching-learning processes which ensures tailor made programmes, effective teaching learning processes, creation of enabling habitat, pro-active participation of industry, embedding of stakeholders at every step of the value chain and others. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To develop the department into a center of excellence in education, research, training and consultancy to the extent that it becomes a significant player in the technical and overall development of the country and with skill-based knowledge achieve new horizons. 01 Produce professionally brilliant and motivated Engineers in the field of Civil Engineering. 02 Undertake developmental research, consultancy and technical interaction with industry. 03 Meet the global need of competent and dedicated professionals through research & development, consultancy & extension activities which are relevant to the needs of mankind. 04 Execute community driven, holistic programs with diverse and inclusive governance.
